what: Japanese cards that break a rule and want regenerating.
generatedFrom: data/batches-ja, every register of every card

rules.E-teaser-reused: anticipateJa repeats a line another card already uses. Compared AS DISPLAYED, so 「神 | 対応！」 and 「神対応！」 count as the same line; the deck validator compares the raw string and so reports 361 where this reports 398.
rules.4.3-names-meaning: leadJa contains the card's own gloss. 4.3 says show the meaning, never name it. Listed per register, because the three word the same scene differently and usually only one of them leaks.
rules.U1-ceiling: usageEn uses an English word above the card's own CEFR level, judged against CEFR-J 1.5 + Octanove 1.0 + every headword either deck teaches at the level it teaches it (rule 9.2).

reasons.detail: usageEn uses "last" (A2) on a A1 card — "I sent her a _____ last night."
